title: Edge-to-Edge Safe Areas, Mobile UI & Fallback Fixes
releaseNotes: Added Android 15/16 edge-to-edge safe-area spacing and smooth keyboard resizing across onboarding, chat, maps, and navigation.
Fixed compact 320px-375px screen layouts across schedules, QR sharing, fare calculator, GPA, budget, weather, and emergency views.
Added clear retry states, external link safety checks, empty search resets, and Android hardware back navigation across modals and drawers.
